local_visual_evidence.caption: Algorithm 1: Brief algorithm framework for grid strategy
steps: if p^t > p^{t-1} && Cross k grids: a^t <- Sell k units
else if p^t < p^{t-1} && Cross k grids: a^t <- Buy k units
if t <= T_end go back to Step6
